candidate_scope: Original native22 language checkpoints only; threshold34 requires its own installed full replay before this verifier can accept its artifact.
prerequisites: Both language installed replay reports complete, artifact-bound, parity passing, and all development/calibration formal/conversational counts meet unchanged99% recall and5% false-review gates. Recompute eligibility from counts before opening held-out messages.
selection: Freeze plan digest, candidate artifact hashes and installed report hashes before reading reserved files. No candidate choice or threshold tuning using reserved results.
evaluation: Actual installed CPU float32 runtime on all three pinned reserved probes. Each probe and language must meet99% recall and5% false-review counts, abstentions errors; no pooled metric substitutes for a failed population.
duplicates: Separate per-set counts plus exact-input deduplicated totals. Conflicting labels or decisions for repeated inputs are an error. Normalization variants remain distinct but are not independent observations.
limitations: Small related authored synthetic sets; no independent annotation, no analyst-blind claim, no population-accuracy guarantee. Passing is not automatic stable-release approval.
